tracked_worktree: clean before review and report writes
review_kind: Source inspection only; no source edits or project execution

source_accounting.native_sdk: Local Cargo registry source pinned by Cargo.lock: wgpu 29.0.4 and wgpu-core 29.0.4

actionable_findings.ownership: Root submission helper and guide repair
actionable_findings.mismatch: Same native provider is weaker than the logical-device identity required by native queue submission. The first helper sentence gives encoder lineage, but the complete queue/device precondition remains imprecise.
actionable_findings.evidence: wgpu-core 29.0.4 src/device/queue.rs:1823 calls command_buffer.same_device_as(queue). Encoder finish routes its error to its creating device sink; queue submit routes to the queue sink.
actionable_findings.replacement: The encoder must be created by context.device, and context.queue must belong to that same logical wgpu::Device. Sharing a backend or physical adapter is insufficient.
actionable_findings.acceptance: Both locations state exact logical-device lineage without claiming runtime validation of arbitrary public WgpuContext field combinations.

actionable_findings.ownership: #780 Kernel owner; agreement requested by root
actionable_findings.mismatch: Comments say one-device validation scopes must not interleave and two compilation threads interleave badly. Native wgpu std is now explicit; SDK error-scope stacks are per thread, so that rationale is false for current native builds.
actionable_findings.evidence: wgpu 29.0.4 src/api/device.rs:434-435 and src/backend/wgpu_core/thread_id.rs select thread-local stacks under std; the helper guard is !Send/!Sync.
actionable_findings.replacement: Remove the cross-thread error-scope interleaving explanation. If COMPILING remains, document only its established application-level purpose, such as serializing this module's kernel compilation; do not claim the SDK requires cross-thread scope serialization.
actionable_findings.acceptance: Both compilation comments no longer claim cross-thread scope interference under native std; owner resolves any remaining lock intent without an unsupported performance or correctness promise.

required_owner_dependencies.issue: Old blanket standalone-submit/uniform-allocation/performance claims remain. Explicit native std now also makes cross-thread scope-interleaving rationale stale: SDK scopes are thread-local.
required_owner_dependencies.remedy: Owner updates architecture/allocation descriptions to actual current paths and explains any retained compilation lock from an established contract, without claiming native cross-thread scope interleaving.

required_owner_dependencies.issue: Root guide correctly warns to discard pending handles after failed submission, but owning API docs still omit callback-drop/Pending behavior and source still asserts CPU never stalls. Existing test callers ignore the new batch submit Result.
required_owner_dependencies.remedy: Owner documents helper-Ok mapping initiation, separate mapping completion, discard-on-submit-error/discarded-batch, native blocking wait in Readback::read, and adapts existing callers without adding tests.

required_owner_dependencies.issue: Remaining agreed #780 producer/count/cache/layout/parser/mode/caller families and retained #774/F19 paths are required; this bounded checkpoint does not clear them.

assessed_contracts: Submit scopes cover encoder.finish and queue.submit separately; captured finalization error returns before queue submission.
Core error-scope result is immediately ready; helper introduces no device PollType::Wait or GPU completion operation.
Only Validation filter is captured; other error classes, later device health and device-handled policies are not promised.
Native explicit std distinguishes per-thread scope stacks; guards are !Send and !Sync and are consumed synchronously.
Browser helper skips synchronous scopes; WebGPU pop returns a JavaScript promise. No browser runtime verdict.
KernelBatch application callbacks run in order only after helper Ok, unlike separate native SDK deferred actions or GPU completion callbacks.
Batch and standalone dispatch preserve actual wgpu cause via ComputePassError::Native; ten texture submission delegations preserve it.
Recorder Ok and RecordedDispatchCount describe host recording, not final native encoding acceptance or GPU execution.
Source cache publishes build-closure Ok outcomes, can race, and does not prove browser/device-handled native acceptance.
Existing converter scope includes immediate binding creation and encoder finalization; later queue scope remains separate.
limits: No source edits, project checks, builds, tests, scanners, generators, runtime execution, push, CI request or external post.
No tests, cases, helpers, assertions or doctests added or altered.
Existing fixtures inspected as source only; no passing test or compile claim.
This is the twelve-path repair review and affected documentation graph, not a complete final review of all main-to-HEAD paths.
Earlier recorder-scope acceptance assurances remain withdrawn; this review does not restore those statements.
Final integrated thirteen-lens and Code/Rule/Comment reviews and hosted checks must agree on the final pushed revision.
